review.policy: Read only the frozen eight online rules and 35 reference rules; enumerate requested facts/conditions and check every same-corpus document for direct or equivalent support. In multi-gold cases each listed document independently supports the requested conclusion. Topical overlap, user assertions and a contact-merchant fallback do not provide missing numeric/date/transaction facts. Explicit policy denials are answerable, not absent evidence.
review.negativeReview: For each no-answer case record visible near-miss docs and the exact missing fact. For each scope case check full trusted scope and forbid out-of-scope or inactive sources. Keep numeric facts supplied only by users out of gold.
review.novelty: Exact queries differ from both earlier splits; new conditional, false-premise, capability-versus-fact, numeric-boundary and historical-time combinations. Limited shared policy corpus prevents a claim of independent intent distribution or statistical generalization.
review.c1: No deferred or multi-turn context cases in this split.
review.retuning: Use this set once with a pre-frozen configuration. Any adjustment based on its results is development feedback and requires a further fresh validation set.
